answer_1.quote: We present a structured, behaviorally grounded evaluation of personality-prompted LLMs in adversarial negotiation, using a multi-perspective framework to compare their linguistic, emotional, and strategic behaviors with human data.

answer_2.quote: We extract a set of 10 LIWC features... compute the normalized conversational linguistic distance (nCLiD)... Anger intensity was annotated... we use Dynamic Time Warping (DTW) to compare anger trajectories... we compute area under the anger intensity curves (AUC)... we compute distributional gaps using the JSD metric for strategic behavior.
